name: lagged-outcome-short-series
title: Lagged outcome with person-mean centring and short series
planted: The formula regresses the outcome on its own lag centred at the person mean over 10 occasions, a lag whose coefficient is biased in short series.

issue.message: The column 'y_lag_pc' is an outcome, is derived from one or holds the trials of the response, so the outcome-blind checks cannot read it.

planned.needs: The intensive-longitudinal block and Stream A.
planned.description: The bias of the coefficient of a lagged outcome, centred at the person mean, in series as short as those of the data.

deferred.reason: Vocabulary 0.1 cannot state how a lag is built within persons, days and sessions, so the lag columns are declared outcome_derived, which Stream B refuses with E6069.
